ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets, bright green with darker green tips and pale green stems, firm and slightly glossy, cut into several bunches of roughly 2-4 cm across, clustered on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Single piece of cooked poultry-like meat with golden-brown, slightly charred and crisp-looking skin, flaky fibrous texture showing layered strands, dry-looking surface with some darker speckled seasoning, roughly 9 cm long by 4 cm wide and 2-3 cm thick, sitting at the right center of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Small tan-brown grains or legumes, matte with slightly rough surface, scattered and mounded loosely beside the meat, with a few thin green herb fragments mixed in, covering about 10 percent of the plate area in a pile about 6 cm across and 1-1.5 cm high | 60
